notes: Compact-label registry for check_android_strings.py and the PWA i18n compact test (docs/local/PLAN_UI_STRING_FIT.md). Keys here render in fixed-width UI (chips, tabs, status lines, buttons, meal slots, bottom-nav labels, widget cards) where long translations truncate or overflow. Rules: value length <= budgetChars (12 Latin chars; CJK glyphs are narrow and count at 0.5) and <= budgetCjkChars (8 CJK chars). perKeyOverrides widen the budget for elements with more room (status lines include the value; bottom-nav labels fit 13-14 chars; full-width sheet rows fit more) and mark valueFirst keys whose first placeholder must precede the first word (EN '10,7g over' -> DE '10,7g drüber', NOT 'drüber 10,7g'). Prose keys are simply not listed here. pwaKeyMap maps Android keys to the PWA catalog keys that are actually rendered in PWA UI (nav, action.log, progress ranges); meal.* and action.retry are defined in PWA catalogs but not rendered, so they are not gated there. See docs/LOCALIZATION.md 'Compact labels'.
